checks.comparison: Lines 202-203: B fresh samples at W_t, G_t = (1/B) sum. step accumulates B replies queried at the unchanged point W_t and forms (1/B)(batch+g); sampleOracle gives call k the k-th sample; batchGradient gives the same G_t with samples tB..tB+B-1.
Line 204: M_0 = G_0, M_t = beta M_{t-1} + (1-beta) G_t for t>0. Both step (if s.iter = 0 then G else beta*momentum + (1-beta)*G) and iterationStep implement exactly this.

Line 224: compact SVD G = U S V^T, update U V^T, 0 for G = 0. orthogonalize = sum_{sigma_i > 0} sigma_i^{-1} (A v_i) v_i^T over an orthonormal eigenbasis of A^T A = sum u_i v_i^T = U V^T; zero matrix gives 0.
Lines 205-206: SVD of M_t and W_{t+1} = W_t - eta U_t V_t^T with eta_t = eta. step/iterationStep use W - eta * orthogonalize M with orthogonalize = U V^T of the compact SVD.
Definition 3.5: What is eps-nuclear stationary iff ||grad f(What)||_* <= eps. NuclearStationary f W eps := nuclearNorm (gradient f W) <= eps, identical.

Source norms (line 143): ||A||_F (Mat's EuclideanSpace norm), ||A||_* = sum of singular values (nuclearNorm = sum sqrt(eig(A^T A))), ||A||_op (spectralNorm = l2 operator norm). All three faithfully defined; the tensor operator norm is not needed here (A47 uses the trilinear form in setup48).

Lines 146-150: problem over W in R^{m x n}, f^* = inf f, r = min{m,n}, f_v(vec W) = f(W). This unit provides the matrix space Mat m n (whose coordinates (i,j) realize vec, so f_v and f are the same function on the same Euclidean space) and the matrix bijection; f^* (iInf) and r (min m n) are introduced where used in the setups, and the expectation representation f = E f(.;xi) is deliberately not imposed (abstract unbiased oracle, accepted at graph/plan review).
No extra structure: batching by counting calls is the faithful execution of 'sample a batch'; the formula carries the exact 1/B factor.
The stored initial momentum 0 is never used because the iter = 0 branch returns G; no added damping or bias correction.
Choice-free in value (polar factor); the planned DMAT lemma orthogonalize_eq_of_svd will certify equality with every compact SVD. No approximation (not Newton-Schulz).
Constant step eta from Public as in the theorems; orthogonalization applied to M_t (not G_t); no extra projection or normalization.
Exactly the source predicate; gradient is the Frobenius gradient.
Every declared norm is a standard definition of the corresponding source norm; nothing extra. Lambda-norm is not used by the targets, correctly omitted.
No unjustified component: Mat and toMatrix/ofMatrix are pure representations of R^{m x n}.

No domain restrictions are built into the definitions (total for all m, n, eta, beta, B, T, W0); the constraints beta in [0,1), B>=1, eta>0, T>=1, m,n>=1 belong to the setups' valid predicates. For B = 0 the state machine is total (finalizes every call with a 1/0 = 0 factor) but such parameters are excluded by valid.
Dependent typing ties every matrix to Public p's dimensions (Mat p.m p.n); trajectory/batchGradient take the same p, g, s as the execution; the sample index tB + j matches call numbering.
Only one Prop (NuclearStationary), with the correct polarity (<= eps). No hidden assumptions in definitions.
This unit adds no assumptions; IID and unbiasedness live in the setup (A33).
Formulas: (1/B)(sum), beta M + (1-beta) G, W - eta UV^T, sum of sqrt eigenvalues, l2 operator norm: all exact.

Initialization (W0, iteration 0), query at the current point with oracle 0, B replies per iteration, M_0 = G_0 then EMA, update with orthogonalized momentum, output the recorded iterates W_0..W_T. Execution under budget T*B is planned to be certified by execute_muon (DEXEC1).

Algorithm seed is Unit with dirac law (no algorithmic randomness, as in Algorithm 1); oracle randomness: seeds s k with joint law P, answer g(W, s k). The i.i.d. requirement is added in the setup, not here; no product law prescribed.
No convergence claim in this unit; NuclearStationary provides the stationarity notion used by complexity clauses.

Mat as EuclideanSpace over index pairs (vec identification), matrix bridge toMatrix/ofMatrix, singular values via eigenvalues of A^T A, U V^T via eigenvectors: all faithful representations; basis-choice independence to be proved in DMAT.

Providers inspected: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues/eigenvectorBasis (real eigenvalues, orthonormal basis), Matrix.toEuclideanLin (linear map between l2 spaces), LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap and its norm, Matrix.vecMulVec (outer product), Matrix.mulVec, gradient (inner-product-space gradient), Function.update, Nat.iterate, Real.sqrt; all used with their standard meaning.

The unit depends only on LongTails.Template and Mathlib; downstream units (setups, DEXEC1, DMAT) consume these definitions as planned. No sorry, no axioms beyond propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound (inventory axioms).
Zero matrix: all sigma_i = 0, orthogonalize = 0 (no division); t = 0 uses M_0 = G_0; B = 1 finalizes every call; iterates beyond T are irrelevant (output indexed by Fin (T+1)).
